documents.population: Applicants with foreign or international examinations to bachelor programmes (all taught in Danish)
documents.notes: University of Copenhagen bachelor admission pages; applications through optagelse.dk by 15 March 12:00, admission requirements fulfilled by 5 July 12:00 (the checklist names 'if you graduate in 2026', an application-cycle label). All bachelor programmes are taught in Danish. Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): documentation of Danish language qualifications (Studieprøven i dansk som andetsprog or Dansk A), documentation of supplementary courses, taught hours per subject (if necessary), residence permit (non-EU/EEA citizens), power of attorney, school letter for certificates issued after 5 July.

items.quote: you must start filling in the application form and uploading all your documents in due time before the deadline.
a copy of your original Diploma and a transcript of records (all the courses that you have had at school) issued by the school
Please include information and transcripts of levels obtained in the relevant subjects (for example A/O level, AP-level).
If the documents are not in one of the major European languages or in Norwegian or Swedish, they must be accompanied, not substituted, by officially translated and certified copies.
items.condition: documents not in a major European language, Norwegian or Swedish
